arabic: إِذْ أَوَى الْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى الْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
transliteration: Idh awa al-fityatu ila al-kahfi faqaloo rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi lana min amrina rashada
translation: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
transliteration: Rabbana la tuakhidhna in nasina aw akhtana
translation: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we forget or make a mistake.

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً
transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh quloobana bada idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah
translation: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us.
caption_topic: keep our hearts on your guidance

translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ
transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata ayun
translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes.
caption_topic: grant us comfort in our families

translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves.

arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
transliteration: Anni massaniya ad-durru wa anta arhamur rahimeen
translation: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
Upon Allah we rely.

arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً
transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan
translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter.
caption_topic: good in this world and the next

translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer.
caption_topic: make me an establisher of prayer

translation: Our Lord, accept this from us.
Our Lord, make us devoted to You.
Our Lord, forgive our sins.
O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty.
Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly.
caption_topic: you did not create this aimlessly

translation: My Lord, forgive and have mercy.
My Lord, expand for me my chest.
And ease for me my task.
And untie the knot from my tongue.
caption_topic: untie the knot from my tongue

translation: So they may understand my speech.
caption_topic: so they may understand my speech

arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeer
translation: My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send down to me.
caption_topic: I am in need of your good

arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimeen
translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been among the wrongdoers.
caption_topic: exalted are you I was among the wrongdoers

translation: My Lord, do not leave me alone.
Cause me to die as a Muslim.
caption_topic: cause me to die as a Muslim

translation: Guide us to the Straight Path.
caption_topic: guide us to the straight path
